name: Native Overview
author: Battlelamb
description: Find existing windows across workspaces. Search app/title words; Enter focuses, Ctrl+M brings the selection here, Ctrl+Space filters this workspace. Configure (Ctrl+,) saves default scope, stable name/workspace order and thumbnail visibility; Reset restores Overview options only. Open: omarchy-shell shell toggle battlelamb.native-overview '{}'. Requires Omarchy Quattro. Existing Super+D stays unchanged; no keys are installed automatically.
